lower_abs.name: Lower Abs
lower_abs.headline: Lower Abs Strength
lower_abs.description: Lower abdomen, from just above your belly button to your pubis. The lower half of the six pack abs.

upper_abs.name: Upper Abs
upper_abs.headline: Upper Abs Strength
upper_abs.description: Upper abdomen, from just above your belly button to your sternum. The upper half of the six pack abs.

back_shoulder.name: Back Shoulder
back_shoulder.headline: Back Shoulder Strength
back_shoulder.description: Outer region of your upper back as well as the back area of your shoulder.

lats.name: Lats
lats.headline: Lats Strength
lats.description: Largest muscle of your back, spanning from the lower to middle regions creating a v shape.

quads.name: Quads
quads.headline: Quads Strength
quads.description: Muscles spanning the front of your thigh.

lower_tricep.name: Lower Tricep
lower_tricep.headline: Lower Tricep Strength
lower_tricep.description: Lower tricep, close to your elbow.

upper_back.name: Upper Back
upper_back.headline: Upper Back Strength
upper_back.description: A significant portion of the upper region of your back. It is widest in the middle, forming a diamond shape that connects the middle of your back to both of your shoulder blades and the upper portion of your neck. It is comprised of three regions. Each region has a different function and is trained in different ways.

lower_back.name: Lower Back
lower_back.headline: Lower Back Strength
lower_back.description: Center region of your back, spanning from the pelvis to just below the neck. However, parts of it are hidden beneath other muscles. The lower portion is the most visible.

hamstrings.name: Hamstrings
hamstrings.headline: Hamstrings Strength
hamstrings.description: Muscles spanning the back of your thigh.

lower_chest.name: Lower Chest
lower_chest.headline: Lower Chest Strength
lower_chest.description: Largest portion of your chest, spanning from your sternum to your shoulder. It takes up a majority of your chest and is multiple times larger than your clavicular head.

upper_chest.name: Upper Chest
upper_chest.headline: Upper Chest Strength
upper_chest.description: Smallest portion of your chest, spanning from your clavicle to your shoulder. It takes up a very small area of your chest and is multiple times smaller than your sternal head.

inner_forearm.name: Inner Forearm
inner_forearm.headline: Inner Forearm Strength
inner_forearm.description: A group of muscles on the inside of your lower arm.

outer_forearm.name: Outer Forearm
outer_forearm.headline: Outer Forearm Strength
outer_forearm.description: A group of muscles on the outside and sides of your lower arm.

calves.name: Calves
calves.headline: Calves Strength
calves.description: A group of muscles on the back of your lower leg that spans from your heel to your knee.
